name: UX Research to Design
description: Evidence-backed interaction design that keeps observed behavior separate from designer mythology.

tasks.name: Frame research question
tasks.objective: Define the product decision to inform, target users/context, known assumptions, behaviors to observe, sample limitations, accessibility considerations, and what evidence would change the team’s current belief.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Research questions map to product decisions, not generic curiosity.

tasks.name: Observe users
tasks.objective: Run interviews, contextual inquiry, diary study, support-log analysis, or usability sessions appropriate to the decision. Avoid leading prompts and record behavior, context, quotes, and interpretation separately.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Findings retain evidence and sample context.

tasks.name: Model tasks and friction
tasks.objective: Synthesize recurring goals, triggers, mental models, task sequences, workarounds, errors, accessibility barriers, and unmet needs. Do not turn demographic anecdotes into invented personas.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each major insight traces to observed evidence.

tasks.name: Design interaction model
tasks.objective: Create information architecture, task flows, states, error/recovery paths, content requirements, permissions/consent points, responsive behavior, and accessibility semantics before surface polish.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Primary and failure paths are represented, not only happy-path screens.

tasks.name: Prototype and test
tasks.objective: Build the minimum fidelity needed to test risky interaction assumptions. Run scenario-based usability sessions without coaching, capture completion/error patterns, then distinguish design defects from prototype limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Material changes respond to observed failures or explicit product tradeoffs.

tasks.name: Accessibility and handoff
tasks.objective: Audit keyboard/focus, semantics, contrast, text scaling, motion, target sizes, errors, screen-reader behavior, and content clarity as relevant. Deliver component/state specifications, rationale, edge cases, and unresolved questions.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Handoff includes states and behavior sufficient for implementation without guessing.
